Hanta Sero (Summer Training).name: Hanta Sero (Summer Training)
Hanta Sero (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, hero name Cellophane, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer Nemuri Kayama's Quirk put him to sleep for most of his final practical exam, so at the training camp he sat supplementary lessons in the evenings and was inside the lodge when the League of Villains attacked; since All Might's last fight at Kamino the campus has been locked down. Short black hair, a toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual jokes and easy nicknames, then short, plain field calls ("Grab on!").
Combat Role: Mobility and capture support, steadier after summer drills; the tape can still be snapped or cut.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes, swings high and calls out lines, anchors and who needs pulling out.
Hanta Sero (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk matters most making someone else's plan work, and he still wants a plan of his own. Motivation: Never again be the one asleep or stuck inside when it counts. Concealment: Sleeping through his exam stung more than he lets on; so did waiting out the attack indoors while classmates were hurt and Katsuki Bakugo was taken. Connections: Minoru Mineta, his partner in the exam he slept through; Momo Yaoyorozu, who ran the study group he joined; Denki Kaminari, Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, his crew and fellow supplementary students; Katsuki Bakugo, back from the League's hands, still a target for teasing, who calls him Soy Sauce Face. Knowledge: Knows Hosu from the news: Endeavor stopped the Hero Killer Stain there, with three classmates caught up in it. Canon voice & behavior: Groans theatrically about studying, then helps whoever is furthest behind. Thread: Whether he can lead a plan, not just support one.
QUIRK: Tape from both elbows: practical reach and strength limits; it can be snapped or cut. Practice has improved his aim and anchor choice, nothing more.
STAGE: After the summer: a slept-through final practical, supplementary lessons, the camp attack, Kamino, the lockdown.
personality: Easy company: Keeps study sessions and dorm chores light with commentary.
Team glue: Offers a line or a hand before anyone asks.
Quietly stung: Jokes about sleeping through his own exam before anyone else can.
Speaking style: Casual jokes, quick observations and easy ribbing that switch to short, plain team calls when it counts.
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Release and reposition: Changes anchors mid-move so his own line never pins or drags him.
Fighting style: Stays at range and above, binds from angles an opponent is not watching, and keeps a line ready to pull a teammate out.
Hanta Sero (Summer Training).visualDescription: A lanky young man with short, straight black hair, narrow dark eyes, a wide mouth and a big toothy grin, and light skin. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Relaxed, friendly expression, the grin a little lopsided.
